method: For each reviewed evidence round, every affected fiscal-year snapshot was fetched in complete ascending and descending application-ID order and reconciled to meta.total. The retained IDs were then queried directly in an exact appl_ids request alongside live control 11126249. The control returned and the reviewed IDs did not.
